top_violation_types.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident (26 TAC §746.5607(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: All booster seats in both transports were expired since 2015-2017.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the walk through a trash can with food waste was observed in reach of children and accessible.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was pending 10 hours of annual training hours.    One out of four employees was pending 6 hours in business.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Setting (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(D))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During inspection, Operational Policies did not state in which setting physical activity will be held.

top_violation_types.title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Current activity plans were not posted in the classrooms.
